verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a public REST API (v1 and v2) in depth, with token and OAuth 2.0 authentication, rate-limit token costs, OpenAPI 3 specs for both versions, concrete endpoint references for deals, leads, persons and organizations, an official Node.js client, and a developer sandbox. That is enough for an AI-native user to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works in practice; the community evidence does not address the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests. The API is stateless – all requests are validated against an API token.
you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both v1 and v2 APIs) into your tool of choice
You can use our API to create public or private apps using OAuth 2.0 and integrations via API token.
Convert a deal to a lead POST /api/v2/deals/{id}/convert/lead
